label: California auto liability minimum, bodily injury or death of one person
applies: The liability limit a policy must carry to satisfy California financial responsibility
movesWhen: By statute on 1 January 2035, stated as an increment rather than as a resulting figure
instrument: Stats. 2022, Ch. 717 (SB 1107), the section as amended by Stats. 2023, Ch. 204, Sec. 19 (AB 1140)
note: Operative from 1 January 2025, replacing $15,000 which applied through 31 December 2024. The 2035 step is expressed in the section as an increase BY $20,000, not as a resulting limit; applied to the current figure that produces $50,000, and the increment must not be quoted as the 2035 limit.
author: Aaron Bollinger
